 Appearance :

 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Nityanand, App.
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
 Oral Order
2 12-01-2024
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 504, 506/34 & 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Petitioner, who is husband of opposite party no2., is said to have ousted the opposite party no.2 from her matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.

Petitioner has neither made any dowry demand nor drove her out of her matrimonial home nor tormented her over Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.84330 of 2023(2)
dt.12-01-2024 the demand of dowry.
He is still ready to keep her with full honour and dignity.

The petitioner has relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @
Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in 2006 (3) PLJR 182.
5.

1 amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Masaudhi P.S. Case No. 431 of 2023, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.,
6.
